observations.title: Printed Stationery Register not Maintained
observations.observation: A memorandum Register for the printed Stationary should be maintained by the branch. It was observed during the audit that Printed Stationery Register was not maintained. At the receipt of printed stationary, all the items were distributed to the concerned for their subsequent usage.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Printed Stationery register shall be checked and signed by the Branch Head, quarterly.' The officer authorized by BH shall be responsible for checking receipt and issuance of printed stationery stock against acknowledgement.
observations.audit_view: Printed stationery register is a control over pre-printed documents. Its absence creates risk of unauthorized use of official stationery.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Chart of Account Needs Correction
observations.observation: Sub accounts were opened in inappropriate parent category of 'Advance to Suppliers'. Accountants at branch level only have rights to open accounts in certain categories, creating structural issues in the COA.
observations.recommendation: To present a fair view of accounts, the concerned heads should be revised and transferred to related parent head categories. RO Finance should consult HO Finance/IT for resolution of the system constraint.
observations.audit_view: RO Finance department should consult HO Finance/IT department for the resolution of the system constraint that forces incorrect account creation.
observations.typical_response: Accountants at branch level only have rights to open accounts in Advance to Supplier, Banks and Advance to Staff.

observations.title: Science Laboratory Stock Register Discrepancies
observations.observation: Laboratory stock registers were not validated by Branch Head; stock was not kept systematically with items from one lab kept in another; physical stock did not match with records; actual consumption not recorded on actual basis (stocktake on intervals with difference posted as consumption).
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Branch Head shall verify the laboratory registers on monthly basis.' Physical balance should be matched with records. Consumption should be recorded on actual basis.
observations.audit_view: Discrepancies in laboratory stock registers indicate poor asset management in laboratories. Monthly BH validation is mandatory.
observations.typical_response: Laboratory In-charges have been instructed to maintain records regularly. BH will now validate and sign registers monthly.

observations.title: Track Record of Quotations not Maintained
observations.observation: For procurements valuing more than Rs. 100,000, track records of quotations were not being kept by the branch. Purchase Requisition file was also not maintained.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'For Procurements valuing more than Rs. 100,000 a track of quotations received shall be maintained at Branch duly authenticated by PC to ensure that all quotations received are properly accounted for.' PR file must be maintained with copies of all PRs.
observations.audit_view: Track record of quotations above PKR 100,000 is essential for procurement transparency and auditability.
observations.typical_response: A proper filing system has now been implemented.

observations.title: Balance Confirmation Certificates not Obtained
observations.observation: Branch was unable to provide certain balance confirmation certificates from vendors/suppliers. A vendor (M/s Rang Studio) claimed Rs. 60,000 as receivable from the Branch while branch records show no amount payable.
observations.recommendation: For clarity of payables/receivables recorded in books of account, balance confirmation certificates should be obtained from all vendors at regular intervals. Discrepancies must be promptly investigated and reconciled.
observations.audit_view: The difference of Rs. 60,000 with M/S Rang Studio should be reconciled and books of account updated at the earliest. Balance confirmation should be obtained within specified time limits.
observations.typical_response: Most vendors ignore this request. Regarding M/s Rang Studio, as per our record no amount is payable.

observations.title: Unapproved Vouchers
observations.observation: As per policy, accountant should obtain approval from Competent Authority before posting a voucher in the module. However, it was observed that the branch was not properly following this practice. Unapproved vouchers were observed during the audit.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'BA is responsible for recording all receipts, payments and relevant entries in the module on daily basis after obtaining approval from the BH.'
observations.typical_response: Action has been taken for future compliance. In future we will be more careful.

observations.title: Payable Against Examination Fee / IB / Other Liabilities
observations.observation: During the audit, payables against Examination Fee, IB, and Other Liabilities amounting to Rs. 5.8 M were appearing in the Trial Balance. These included pending IB exam fee heads in which student exam fee had been booked.
observations.recommendation: Such payables should be settled as per guidelines provided by RO. Branch is requested to prepare the detail of payables including the aging, and coordinate with RO in this regard.
observations.typical_response: These are the IB exam heads in which student exam fee has been booked. All remaining dues will be paid back to students.

observations.title: Long Outstanding Receivables from Vendors
observations.observation: During the audit, long outstanding receivables were identified from vendors. Recovery from one vendor was pending since June 2018 (credited in 2020 upon RO instruction). Recovery from another vendor was recommended in the previous audit due to excess payment.
observations.recommendation: Management is requested to check any other receivables and take measures for recovering long outstanding receivables from vendors. A proper follow-up mechanism should be established.
observations.typical_response: Recovery from one vendor will be done; for other vendors there are many follow-ups and RO is also aware.

observations.title: Pending Adjustment of Advance IB-Branch Imprest Account
observations.observation: During the audit, a receivable balance of Rs. 7,480,136 was appearing under Advance IB–Br. Imprest A/c as of 11 August 2025. IB-related expenses are booked in this account and sent to RO for adjustment. However, the receivable balance had been accumulating since May 2025. A BR of Rs. 6,142,396 was recorded on 18 August 2025 (post-audit date), reducing the outstanding balance to Rs. 1,337,740.
observations.recommendation: Timely adjustments should be ensured. Periodic monitoring and review of such accounts should be conducted to ensure balances are cleared promptly and accurately.
observations.typical_response: Action taken and balance amount is received from HO.

observations.title: Discrepancies in TA/DA Claims
observations.observation: During checking of travel claims, certain discrepancies were identified: number of days for travel and stay not correctly calculated resulting in discrepancies in claimed amounts; Rs. 14,500 paid against medicines and hospitalization with no supporting bills or approval for missing bills; Work Order and Comparative Statement of Quotations were attached (not applicable for TA/DA claims); claims were submitted with a delay of 6 to 7 months.
observations.recommendation: Correct calculation of days should be ensured. Supporting documents should be attached where applicable. Only relevant documents for TA/DA claims should be attached. Claims should be submitted within a defined timeline — all claims shall be submitted within seven (7) days of return to home station.
observations.typical_response: At school level we will decide a way forward for these excess and less payments.

observations.title: Collection of Utility Connection Share not Properly Practiced
observations.observation: As per standard company practice, utility charges should be regularly collected from relevant parties. However, recovery was pending for July 2025, and instead of collecting on a monthly basis, the branch was adjusting the amounts on an annual basis.
observations.recommendation: As per company practice, charges should be collected on a regular (monthly) basis.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Delay in Submission of Bills
observations.observation: Bills should be submitted in time. During the audit, it was observed that bills were submitted with delay in imprest.
observations.recommendation: Management should ensure that bills are submitted and processed on a timely basis.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Specimen Signature of Branch Personnel not Available
observations.observation: Specimen of signatures help in identifying signatures on bills, purchase requisition, purchase order etc. A copy of the specimen should also be given to CSO because they check imprest, adjustments, and reimbursements. During the audit, it was noted that there were no such specimen signatures available with branch. For example Branch Head, Purchase Committee Members, Accountant or any other personnel signing bills.
observations.recommendation: Specimen signatures should be available with branch as well as same should be forwarded to CSO as well.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: SOP not Available for Staff Lunch Contribution
observations.observation: SOPs had not been devised for the collection, recording, and utilization of staff lunch contributions. The cost of lunch provided against the contribution was also not available.
observations.recommendation: SOPs for staff lunch contributions should be developed.
observations.typical_response: Action has been taken — SOP is developed and shared with RO.

observations.title: Payable Against Honorariums
observations.observation: The honorariums received should be paid on time. However, a payment of Rs. 80,840 against honorariums was pending as per the detail provided by the branch.
observations.recommendation: Branch is requested to coordinate with RO and settle the payment as per the policy/process.
observations.typical_response: As discussed with BH the amount will be given to the relevant person who worked for the respective event.

observations.title: Cash in Hand Account not Maintained
observations.observation: The branch was not maintaining the Cash in Hand Account in BEAMS. Instead of the standard practice, advances were issued to OFA staff etc. and recorded by their names in books of the branch.
observations.recommendation: Branch should record petty expenses in 'Cash in Hand' account as per company policy: 'In order to meet expenses or purchase of goods and services of a minor nature on a day-to-day basis a petty cash balance shall be maintained at Branches.'
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Delay in Salary Disbursement
observations.observation: Salary should be timely disbursed. During the audit, it was observed that there were some delays in salary disbursement.
observations.recommendation: Branch management should ensure timely disbursement of salaries for all employees.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Employee File of Accounts Staff Kept in Branch
observations.observation: Personal files of Accounts Staff were placed in the branch along with other employee files. As per policy, personal files of Branch Accounts Staff should be maintained at their respective Regional Office.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Personal files of Principal, Head Master/Mistress, Senior Master/Mistress and Branch Accounts Staff will be maintained at their respective RO.'
observations.typical_response: Noted. We will send both files of Accounts Staff to HR-RO.

observations.title: Washing Allowance not Given to Support Staff
observations.observation: As per policy, support staff is entitled to a washing allowance of Rs. 250 per month. According to information shared by the branch, uniform (livery items) was issued but washing allowance was not given to certain employees in the same employee category.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Entitled employees shall be given a maintenance allowance (currently at PKR 250 per month), as approved by Head HR, which shall be paid through the payroll.'
observations.typical_response: Noted for compliance and will refer to HR.

observations.title: Livery Maintenance Allowance Paid to Ineligible Staff
observations.observation: Livery Maintenance Allowance was being paid to a Receptionist who had not been provided livery items. Any approval in this regard was also not available.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Entitled employees shall be given a maintenance allowance (currently at PKR 250 per month), as approved by Head HR, which shall be paid through the payroll.' Allowance should only be paid to entitled staff.
observations.typical_response: Action has been taken and request raised to HR.

observations.title: Recoverable from Left Employees
observations.observation: During the audit, relevant branch personnel informed that recoverable amounts were identified from some left employees during calculation of their final settlements.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'In case of failure to clear Company dues, the employee shall not be issued clearance and the experience certificate and shall not be eligible for re-hiring in any of the Beaconhouse and related brand/Branches.'
observations.typical_response: Noted and will refer to HR.

observations.title: Security Refund Cases Processed with Delay
observations.observation: Security Refund claims should be processed on timely basis by the Cluster Support Office. Considerable delay in processing of Security Refund cheque was observed where the security amount has been refunded. Few instances are given below;
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'The parents should be informed that the security refund process will take around 45 days. The security will be refunded after deduction of outstanding dues.'
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Security Refund Report not Generated from ISM/BEAMS
observations.observation: For branch PROs, no intimation, report, or pop-up is generated (branch-wise) through ISM/BEAMS for the preparation and dispatch of student security refund cheques. The feature is not available/accessible at branch level.
observations.recommendation: Keeping in view the importance of this report (branch-wise), there is a need to ensure the availability of this report/option (with view rights only) for more effective working of branch PROs.
observations.audit_view: In our opinion, such a report may be provided to the branch for their support.
observations.typical_response: Student Security Refund is being maintained centrally at the regional office.

observations.title: All Quotations Provided by Selected Vendor (Fake Quotations)
observations.observation: Quotations should be obtained from 3–5 vendors for transactions exceeding PKR 25,000. During audit, cases were identified where all 3 quotations were provided by the selected vendor (Haq Tent Service) in his own handwriting. Contender vendors visited by Audit Team refused to accept the quotations as valid and declared them fake. Purchase Committee admitted negligence in identifying identical handwriting. The vendor admitted to providing all 3 quotations with higher rates on competitors. This activity had been continued for several years.
observations.recommendation: Procurement procedure should be followed as per policy. Branch Head and Purchase Committee must ensure compliance at time of approval. A warning letter should be issued to Purchase Committee members and the vendor should be considered for blacklisting.
observations.audit_view: The explanation provided is not acceptable. Collecting quotations at vendor's convenience cannot justify deviation from policy. The procurement policy provides a provision for urgent/routine requirements which was not utilized. A warning letter should be issued to Purchase Committee members for negligence, and the vendor considered for blacklisting due to submission of fake quotations.
observations.typical_response: Committed to ensuring full compliance. New PMCs will be switched and new quotations have confirmed the vendor is still price competitive.

observations.title: CAPEX Work Done at Higher Rates
observations.observation: Round Stairs were prepared for CAPEX 2024-25 work for Rs. 137,000. Audit team collected a fresh quote for the same work from another vendor at Rs. 93,000 (after adjusting WHT), revealing a variance of 24% above market rates.
observations.recommendation: Fair market analysis should be conducted by the Branch Purchase Committee. Branch Head and Purchase Committee must ensure compliance with company policies at time of approval. PC functions include reviewing negotiated price, terms and conditions, and ensuring equal opportunity to all competitors.
observations.audit_view: The explanation is not agreed. All three quotations were obtained from the beneficiary vendor (as noted in OBS-106), which undermines validity of fair market analysis. The approval process was based on limited and dependent information, reducing transparency.
observations.typical_response: PMC team obtained at least three genuine quotations and work was executed after receiving necessary approval from CSOC.

observations.title: List of Preferred Vendors not Available
observations.observation: List of Preferred Vendors was not available in the branch. For day-to-day procurement activities, a list of preferred vendors should be maintained and regularly updated by Purchase Committee members.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'For day to day procurement activities, vendors may not be formally registered, but a list of preferred vendors shall be maintained. Officers responsible for procurement shall prepare a list of suitable vendors/contractors. This list shall be reviewed/updated by the members of the Purchase Committee.'
observations.typical_response: The said list will be prepared and maintained in the branch.

observations.title: Discrepancy in RO Advances Ledger
observations.observation: During analysis of the advances ledger at the branch, a discrepancy of Rs. 137,000 was observed between the closing balances in the RO Advance Account at branch compared to RO records.
observations.recommendation: The advances ledger at the branch should be reconciled with the ledger maintained by the RO. Any discrepancies should be investigated and resolved promptly.
observations.typical_response: Said discrepancy has been resolved.

observations.title: Electricity Stolen by Canteen Contractor
observations.observation: The canteen contractor was found stealing school electricity by bypassing the sub-meter. Two sockets were affixed on wall bypassing the sub-meter (used for a Microwave Oven and a Fryer). No recovery had been made from the contractor despite the issue being identified in a previous audit.
observations.recommendation: Misappropriated amount should be calculated and recovered from the contractor since the time of the contractor's working in the campus.
observations.typical_response: Amount calculated, recovered (Rs. 37,059) and deposited in branch bank account. Bypass path removed.

observations.title: No Policy for Cambridge Exam Fee Refund
observations.observation: No clear policy existed for handling student refunds for Cambridge exam fee in cases where students do not appear for exams. This led to a credit balance accumulating in the ledger over the years.
observations.recommendation: A clear and comprehensive refund policy should be developed and made available at branch. The policy should outline eligibility criteria, timelines, and conditions under which refunds can be processed or withheld.
observations.typical_response: Branch refer this observation to ROC for guidelines. RO Response: System and Audit department is requested to devise a policy and procedure for this.

observations.title: Third Party Ledger Accounts not Maintained
observations.observation: Complete records of third parties such as Canteen Contractor and Photocopier were not maintained in books of accounts. Ledger account of Canteen Contractor was not opened in BEAMS, and transactions related to electricity consumption of copier and canteen contractor were not posted in books.
observations.recommendation: Ledger accounts of the contractors should be opened and all related transactions should be recorded in the books of accounts to prevent ambiguity and maintain accurate financial records.
observations.typical_response: Ledger accounts of both contractors will be opened in BEAMS.

observations.title: Expenses without Formal Invoices/Bills
observations.observation: Many expenses were incurred against which no invoice/bill was produced. A Cash Payment Voucher was filled in lieu of invoice/bills.
observations.recommendation: Invoices/bills should be produced against expenses incurred.
observations.typical_response: Cash Vouchers were used because vendor did not provide proper bills. Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Expenses Booked in Wrong Head of Account
observations.observation: Certain expenses were booked in wrong Head of Account during verification of imprest adjustments.
observations.recommendation: Bills should be booked in the relevant Head of Account.
observations.typical_response: Branch will assure that bills will be booked in relevant Head of Account in future.

observations.title: Bank Payments Booked through Cash Payment Voucher
observations.observation: Bank payments were booked through 'Cash Payments (IMP)' voucher type instead of Bank Payment Vouchers.
observations.recommendation: Bank Payments should be booked through Bank Payment Vouchers only.
observations.typical_response: Noted for compliance.

observations.title: Record for Bank Signatories not Available in Branch
observations.observation: Records for all bank signatories were not available with the branch. Records available were only for two signatories (Branch Head and Branch Accountant). Signatories from ROC and HO were not communicated to the branch.
observations.recommendation: Records for all bank signatories should be available with the branch.
observations.typical_response: Record handed over to branches now.

observations.title: Cash Collection Activity Balance not Deposited in Bank
observations.observation: A BCP event held on 03.03.2023 with a leftover balance of Rs. 24,000 was not deposited in the bank account as required by policy. The amount was adjusted in another activity held on 02.11.2024, approximately 20 months later.
observations.recommendation: Any leftover amount from cash collection activities should be deposited in the bank account immediately. 'Activities should be planned so cash collection exactly matches expenditure. In case of leftover balance, it should be deposited in bank account promptly by the BA.'
observations.typical_response: Discrepancy occurred due to technical glitch related to Section Coordinator's BEAMS rights issue.

observations.title: Livery Record not Maintained
observations.observation: Record for livery items issued to junior staff was not maintained by the branch. Livery record prior to September 2022 was not available.
observations.recommendation: Record for livery items issued to junior staff should be maintained as per policy.
observations.typical_response: Noted for compliance in future.

observations.title: Registration Fee Deposited Prior to Collection Date
observations.observation: In BEAMS, certain registration fee collections were deposited prior to their collection dates. The deposit dates were apparently wrongly fed by the concerned person.
observations.recommendation: Branch Head should ensure that all receipts and deposits are correctly fed in the system.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Emergency Contact Information of Students Missing in BEAMS
observations.observation: Student data should be updated at the time of feeding admission information of every student. During scrutiny of student record on BEAMS in current audit, it was found that data of students i.e. Emergency contact number were not entered in BEAMS. Few instances are given below: Tejaser Imran Mohd Umer Farooq Asad Ali Muhammad Moosa Laiba Haq Mehar Ali Cheema Laiba Javed Muhammad Ibrahim Fahad Siddiqui
observations.recommendation: Complete information should be updated in BEAMS at an early basis. As per policy: “The PRO and Accountant shall enter Student information in Integrated Student Module (ISM) respectively at the time of admission;”
observations.typical_response: The missing emergency contact details are updated; future admissions will comply with required standards.

observations.title: Memorandum Record of Fixed Assets not Maintained
observations.observation: For the purpose of effective control, certain stock registers shall be maintained by the Branch. School Heads should ensure the safe custody of fixed assets as per the company policy. It was observed during branch audit that stock register of Fixed Assets having cost less than the threshold value (PKR 10,000) was not properly maintained by branch. Instances mentioned as tabulated below; GRN # GRN Dated Quantity 6-Feb-19 Hand Held Lights (Rechargeable) 27-Sep-19 CCTV Camera 20-Aug-19 Network Switch 24 Port D-Link 06-May-19 Traffic Cone 21-Feb-19 CCTV Camera 19-Sep-18 Laptop Lock
observations.recommendation: Stock Registers should be maintained and updated regularly. 'Separate pages/sections shall be used to record each item/article. Receipts and issuance shall be recorded on timely basis. Following Stock Registers shall also be maintained: Music Equipment; Fixed Assets having cost less than PKR 10,000; Sports Register; Teaching Aid Register; Consumable Stationery Register.'
observations.typical_response: Noted. Compliance made and discrepancies resolved.

observations.title: Validated Paint Area Measurement not Available (Branches)
observations.observation: Record of total paintable area duly endorsed by Works Department and OFA was not available at the branch to avoid ambiguity at the time of awarding paint work contracts. The available document was either not prepared or not verified and endorsed by Works Department.
observations.recommendation: Branch should have an updated record of total paint area measurement duly endorsed by RO Works Department.
observations.typical_response: Noted. Will coordinate with RO Works Department to get measurements verified.

observations.title: Books not Available for Physical Verification
observations.observation: Library books were not placed in shelves/racks due to construction in process and shifting of libraries. Physical verification of books was therefore not possible.
observations.recommendation: Branch management should ensure timely provision of selected books for verification. 'Stocktaking of the books should be completed, and library books should be made available for Physical Verification.'
observations.typical_response: The 3rd floor library was handed over a few weeks after reopening due to construction; shelving is now set up.

observations.title: Pending Deposit of Recoveries for Lost Library Books
observations.observation: Amount received against lost books was not deposited or utilized for replacement of books. The list of books against which recoveries were made was also awaited from the library.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Those books lost by the students/teachers/borrowers are recorded by the librarian. Librarians were strictly informed that the people responsible should replace the lost books (with the same ISBN) or deposit the cost of the book in the main account of BSS. In both cases AIDN should be made and sent to RO/HO with the relevant documents.'
observations.typical_response: AIDNs are in process; once done the amount will be deposited in HO account.

observations.title: Detail of Missing Books from Stock Taking not Available
observations.observation: Approximately 224 books were reported as missing after stock taking in Year 2019. However, upon request for the list of missing books and related AIDN, it was found that no such detail was available.
observations.recommendation: As per policy on missing books: 'Missing books are those which are not available in the library neither their issuance record is available with the librarian. An AIDN should be made of missing books with the GRN of replaced books or Payment slips.'
observations.typical_response: No record of missing books prior to 2019 could be traced as none was handed over by the previous library coordinator.

observations.title: Stock Taking Report not Available
observations.observation: Stock taking reports for certain years were not available. At TNS Beaconhouse Defence, EY & PYP stock taking reports for Year 2023 were not available. At Newlands Multan, stock taking for years 2022 and 2023 was pending in the MYP Library.
observations.recommendation: Stocktaking should be done at regular intervals — at least once a year. 'It is the duty of the librarian to submit the Stocktaking Report to the Head Mistress and Regional Office after the process of stocktaking is over.'
observations.typical_response: Previous librarian neither shared nor handed over any documentation before her resignation.

observations.title: Incomplete Data Entry in KOHA
observations.observation: Data in KOHA was not correctly updated in all respects. Zero cost and records with less than 1,000 entries were appearing in the main accession register. Certain columns were left blank.
observations.recommendation: Less than 1,000 books should be recorded in relevant register instead of Main Accession Register. Complete and correct information should be mentioned. Concerned staff should coordinate with RO Librarian for completion of data.
observations.typical_response: Record gaps arose from data migration issues, untrained staff entries during Covid, and undocumented gifted books. A professional librarian is debugging the database.

observations.title: Non-Compliance of Security Guards Contract (Civilian vs Ex-Army)
observations.observation: All guards provided by the security company were Civilian. According to the contract, guards should be 50% Ex-Armed Forces and 50% Civilians. This non-compliance was observed across multiple campuses.
observations.recommendation: As per contract: 'Guards will be 50% Ex-AFs and 50% Civilians Trained.' Non-compliance of security services contract should be reported to concerned office and followed up until issues are resolved.
observations.audit_view: Branch management is requested to coordinate with the Regional Office Security Department to resolve the ongoing non-compliance with the contract clause.
observations.typical_response: Security company is unable to find Ex-Army personnel within the existing package. Penalty is being imposed every month at the rate of Rs. 100 per person per day.

observations.title: Security Related Contracts not Available at Branch
observations.observation: Copies of security-related contracts were not maintained or available at the branch. Without these, branch administration cannot verify compliance with agreed terms and conditions.
observations.recommendation: Copies of contracts should be available to ensure awareness of agreed services and enable timely issue identification and resolution.
observations.typical_response: ROC has been approached for provision of copies of contracts of previous years.

observations.title: Average Fuel Consumption of Generator not Monitored
observations.observation: Monitoring of the generator's average fuel consumption was not being done. OFA/AO is responsible for calculating the average fuel consumption and obtaining the standard fuel average from Manager Admin RO. Unmonitored fuel consumption may lead to untracked variances in fuel efficiency.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'OFA/AO shall calculate the fuel average of the generator on the basis of entries recorded in the logbook, after regular intervals. Fuel Average = Fuel Consumption ÷ Running Hours. Any unusual average shall be reported to the BH/LM.'
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Non-Compliance with Generator Fuelling Procedure
observations.observation: The prescribed procedure for generator fuelling was not being followed. The Security Supervisor was not signing the logbook to verify re-fuelling entries.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Security Supervisor shall review the fueling process and verify the re-fueling entry by signing the logbook.'
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Stock Register for Used Mobile Oil not Properly Maintained
observations.observation: The branch was recording used mobile oil from generators in a plain register from October 2023. However, discrepancies were observed: no record maintained before October 2023; entries not signed by the person making them; entries not validated by relevant authority; cutting and overwriting observed; register only signed once by Manager Admin in August 2025.
observations.recommendation: The stock register should be properly maintained, preferably in a standardized format. 'For the purpose of effective control, certain stock registers shall be maintained by Branches.'
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Logbook for Pool Bike not Maintained
observations.observation: The branch was not maintaining a logbook for the pool motorbike.
observations.recommendation: As per company practice, the logbook should be properly maintained with running detail and maintenance records.
observations.typical_response: Noted for future compliance.

observations.title: Employees Salary Accounts Opened with Delay
observations.observation: Salaries of employees were paid from imprest bank accounts and salary reimbursements were later claimed from RO because employees had opened their salary accounts with delay.
observations.recommendation: For effective and better control, branch should ensure employees open their salary account after hiring. 'The new hired employees are required to provide/open their bank accounts (in the designated bank account) within 15 days of their hiring/joining.'
observations.typical_response: Delay occurred due to non-verification of the new bank account.

observations.title: Recoverable Excess Payments to Left Employees
observations.observation: Negative balances were appearing in final settlement claims of certain left employees indicating excess payments made to them. These excess payments need to be recovered.
observations.recommendation: Excess payments to employees appearing as negative balances in final settlement claims should be timely recovered. 'In case of failure to clear Company dues, the employee shall not be issued the experience certificate and shall not be eligible for re-hiring.'
observations.typical_response: Refer to ROS-HR.

observations.title: Final Settlement Acknowledgement of Left Employees not Available
observations.observation: No acknowledgement over final settlements of left employees was available in school record. As per revised practice, all final settlements are processed by Head Office directly into the bank account of the left employee, but no official email or intimation is shared by HO with the branch and left employee.
observations.recommendation: A proper well-defined procedure should be devised for acknowledgement of final settlement of left employees so that employee record files can be completed with all required documentary evidences.
observations.typical_response: Hardcopies of final settlement are sent to campus even when the amount is transferred online to the employee's bank account.

observations.title: Safe Keeping of School Record
observations.observation: Large number of school record files were dumped in a room at the backside of the school premises. The record was found full of dust and kept unattended in an open place without ensuring its safe custody.
observations.recommendation: Necessary arrangements should be done to ensure safe custody of school record. Files should be placed securely in appropriate cabinets/shelves and maintained in a manner that allows traceability at time of need.
observations.typical_response: Designated staff has been instructed to ensure proper arrangement and safe custody of all school records.

observations.title: Student Registration/Admission Forms Incomplete
observations.observation: Admission/registration forms of some students were found incomplete. Required fields were missing or left blank.
observations.recommendation: Students' Registration/Admission forms should be completed in all respects.
observations.audit_view: Branch should ensure completeness of all student admission/registration forms as the audit was performed on sample basis.
observations.typical_response: Noted for further compliance. Working on updating forms.

observations.title: Withdrawal and Security Refund Form Incomplete
observations.observation: The refund acknowledgement section of 'Withdrawal and Security Refund Form' was not filled in a number of cases. Parents/Guardians signatures were not obtained on the refund acknowledgement section as a matter of practice.
observations.recommendation: Withdrawal and security refund forms should be completely filled. All required sections including refund acknowledgement must be signed by parents/guardians.
observations.audit_view: Branch should ensure completeness of all documents and forms as the audit was performed on sample basis.
observations.typical_response: Noted, will be careful next time.

observations.title: Fixed Asset Codes/Tags not Provided by RO
observations.observation: All Fixed assets should be given numbers/tags on timely basis. Few chairs were found without Fixed Assets Tags/Codes. On further enquiry, it was revealed that GRN against these asset was forwarded to CSO to get the asset codes but CSO has not yet provided fixed asset code. For details see Annexure-J.
observations.recommendation: Fixed assets codes should be issued on timely basis. Concerned official at CSO should look into this matter and make necessary efforts to identify reasons and take appropriate action for its solution. As per School Operations Manual clause “Additions / Disposals / Transfers of Fixed Assets” sub clause 23.5.2: “The whole process shall be completed within 15 working days from occurrence of the transaction/activity”.
observations.audit_view: Concerned official of the branch did not provide/shown any documentary evidence pertaining to the provision of fixed asset codes/tags to us till follow up audit visit.
observations.typical_response: The OFA has been informed and relevant department requested to provide asset codes.

observations.title: Disposal Notes Processed with Delay by RO
observations.observation: AIDNs were processed with significant delay by RO. The whole disposal process should be completed within 15 working days from the date of AIDN before month-end closure procedures. Additionally, during AIDN review, an AIDN was awarded to the lowest bidder at Rs. 3,925 while higher bids of Rs. 4,800 and Rs. 5,510 were available — suggesting incorrect bid selection.
observations.recommendation: AIDNs should be processed on timely basis. 'The whole disposal process shall be completed within 15 working days from the date of AIDN before the month end closure procedures.'
observations.typical_response: Refer to ROS-Fixed Assets Dept.

observations.title: Fixed Assets Held in Branch for Disposal (Pending AIDN)
observations.observation: Numerous broken/damaged fixed assets and items held for disposal were found in the branch without AIDN being prepared and processed. Large quantities of useable and AIDN assets from Gulshan KG3 and Gulshan Primary 3 were also found dumped in the basement.
observations.recommendation: Complete list of assets held for disposal should be available at branch. AIDN of such assets should be timely prepared and processed by the branch to RO.
observations.typical_response: AIDN had already been processed approximately one month prior to the audit. A new AIDN list has been finalized and is currently pending vendor quotations.

observations.title: Surplus Assets Found in Branch
observations.observation: Surplus/unusable assets were found in the branch without being reported to RO through AIDN for transfer to other branches or disposal.
observations.recommendation: Branch should report surplus assets for further process. RO should be informed through AIDN of surplus assets so they can be transferred to other branches where needed or disposed of if necessary.
observations.typical_response: Noted. Items included in AIDN for further processing.

observations.title: Tablets Found Without Screen Protector Sheets
observations.observation: Screen protector sheets were not timely installed on Tablets found in branch library. Delay in installation may result in damage to screen and significant financial loss.
observations.recommendation: Branch should ensure that all tablets should be timely equipped with screen protectors and dealt in accordance with company policy.
observations.typical_response: Tabs are protected with leather covers; however, screen protectors will be obtained for further safety.

observations.title: UPS not Available in Branch Libraries
observations.observation: UPS was not available in the branch libraries. This impacts continuity of library operations during power outages.
observations.recommendation: Branch library should be furnished with necessary resources for smooth running of library operations, including UPS for BEAMS support.
observations.typical_response: Noted. Will demand in upcoming CAPEX 2026-27.

observations.title: Library Books Awaiting AIDN
observations.observation: Approximately 69 library books were kept aside for AIDN in branch library but the disposal process had not been initiated.
observations.recommendation: Library books and all other items kept in library should be appropriately maintained and disposed of in accordance with company's policies and procedures.
observations.typical_response: Books kept separately in a closed cupboard and not in reach of students. Will process disposal during next vacation.

observations.title: Lack of CCTV Coverage in Important Areas
observations.observation: Some important areas of branch premises were not under CCTV camera surveillance including: Stairs Block A, B, C; Staff Rooms in Block A, B, C; Passages in Block A and B.
observations.recommendation: All important spaces in school premises should be thoroughly covered under proper surveillance of CCTV cameras.
observations.typical_response: Most mentioned areas are covered. Stairs Block B and C will be covered in next CAPEX 25-26.

observations.title: Glass Key Box not Installed in Branch
observations.observation: A properly locked glass key box containing necessary branch keys was not installed on a common accessible place in the branch. This is important for emergency access situations.
observations.recommendation: A glass key box with necessary branch keys should be installed on a common easily accessible place in the branch so that in case of emergency the keys can be used by breaking the glass.
observations.typical_response: A new glass key box will be installed at a common accessible place in the branch.

observations.title: Quarterly Firing Practices of Armed Security Guards not Conducted
observations.observation: Quarterly firing practices for armed security guards deputed at the branch were not being conducted by the security company, in non-compliance of clause 17 of the agreement for provision of security services.
observations.recommendation: Security company should ensure quarterly firing practices for armed security guards are conducted on timely basis in accordance with provision of the agreement: 'The contractor will arrange quarterly firing practices that the client's representative will observe.'
observations.typical_response: Refer to ROS-Security Dept. The observation will be duly intimated to the outsourced security company for compliance.

observations.title: Substitute Security Guards not Provided by Security Company
observations.observation: Substitute guards were not provided by the security company in the absence of deployed security guards. Absenteeism of guards was observed without replacement being arranged.
observations.recommendation: Replacement of any ASG who absents from duty shall be the responsibility of the service provider. 'In case a guard absents himself and leaves the place of duty without permission, the contractor shall provide a reliever within two hours upon intimation.'
observations.typical_response: Refer to ROS-Security Dept. The observation will be communicated to the outsourced company for compliance.

observations.title: Backup CCTV Camera not Provided by Security Vendor
observations.observation: Backup CCTV cameras were not provided by SSG when cameras were sent to workshop for repair. As per clause 5 of the CCTV Repair Contract, SSG is obligated to provide backup cameras until faulty equipment is repaired or replaced.
observations.recommendation: Out of order CCTV Cameras should be repaired immediately and in case repair requires workshop, backup cameras should be provided by SSG as per contract clause: 'SSG agrees to provide back-up CCTV Cameras/NVR/XVR/POE Switches till the time the faulty equipment is repaired at the workshop or its replacement is provided.'
observations.typical_response: Refer to ROS-Security Dept.

observations.title: Record of Annual Firing Practice of SSS not Available
observations.observation: Annual firing practice of the School Security Supervisor was conducted in the previous month but no official entry for this in the branch record was found during audit visit.
observations.recommendation: Regional annual firing practice should be conducted at the firing range. 'Official record will also be kept, and at least one time fire is necessary in a year.' Entry in the branch register must be made promptly after each practice.
observations.typical_response: Annual firing practice was conducted on 23rd September 2025 as per SOPs. The omission of entry in the branch register was unintentional and has been updated.

observations.title: Out of Order Assets Found in Security Control Room
observations.observation: Some assets in the School Security Control Room were found in out-of-order condition. Repair work had not been carried out by the branch till the audit date.
observations.recommendation: Out of order assets should be timely repaired so they remain available for intended use. Such assets can be disposed-off if not repairable.
observations.typical_response: All assets found in out-of-order condition have been duly reported in AIDN for disposal.

observations.title: Surplus/Idle Assets in Security Control Room
observations.observation: Surplus CCTV cameras were found in the school security control room. These should be reported to RO for transfer to branches where needed or disposal if necessary.
observations.recommendation: Branch should timely report surplus assets for further process via AIDN.
observations.typical_response: 5 cameras kept as backup for emergency; remaining 17 cameras reported for transfer or AIDN disposal.

observations.title: Excess Printed Stationery Found in Branch
observations.observation: Excess quantities of printed stationery were kept in the school and needed to be transferred to other branches for efficient utilization before arrival of new 50-year logo printed stationery.
observations.recommendation: All excess printed stationery available in the school should be transferred to other branches so they can be utilized before arrival of new 50-year logo printed stationery.
observations.typical_response: Coordinating with cluster branches and providing them printed stationery as per their need.

observations.title: Gate Passes Record not Maintained Properly
observations.observation: To maintain an effective and complete track over inward and outward movement of assets through the branch, record of both inward and outward gate passes should be maintained. During the audit it was observed that only outward gate passes were being filed for the record and no record was maintained for inward movement of the assets.
observations.recommendation: Gate passes should be properly filled and authorized by the concerned officer in order to have better control over movement of goods.
observations.typical_response: Noted. Will ensure proper maintenance of gate pass records.

observations.title: Withholding Tax not Deducted from Payments
observations.observation: Withholding tax was not deducted from payments to vendors/contractors when the payment exceeded the basic threshold mentioned in Income Tax Ordinance 2001.
observations.recommendation: It is recommended that payments to suppliers should be made after deducting tax. As per Income Tax Ordinance section 153 sub-section (1): 'Withholding tax should be deducted from payments including part/advance payments.'
observations.typical_response: Duly noted. Will comply as per recommendations.

observations.title: Recipient Acknowledgement not Obtained on Bank Payments
observations.observation: Recipient's acknowledgement was not obtained on Bank Payment Vouchers at the time of payment.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Acknowledgement of receipt will be obtained from Payee on Bank Payment Voucher at the time of delivering the cheque.'
observations.typical_response: This has been noted and will be well taken care of next time.

observations.title: Delay in Claiming Reimbursement by Branch
observations.observation: Branch reimbursement claims were forwarded with delay. This may lead to shortage of funds for routine expenses.
observations.recommendation: Branch should process reimbursement claims without delay. 'After incurring expenditure approved, the reimbursement claim along with related documents/supports shall be forwarded to the Office responsible to reimburse the amount within 10 days of completion of the activity.'
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern.

observations.title: Separate Voucher Files not Maintained
observations.observation: Files of all types of vouchers (BPV, BRV, and Bank File) were not being maintained according to individual voucher categories. Vouchers were not filed separately and sequentially.
observations.recommendation: A separate file should be used for the filing of each voucher category and vouchers should be filed sequentially.
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern.

observations.title: Bank Deposit Slips not Verified by Branch Head
observations.observation: Bank Deposit slips against Student Registration fee were not verified by the Branch Head.
observations.recommendation: Branch Head should verify the deposit slips as per company policy: 'All columns of student's registration register should be duly completed. The Branch Head shall check BDS and Registration Register on monthly basis.'
observations.typical_response: A few deposit slips were not available since both the PRO and school head had changed.

observations.title: Registration Receipts not Signed by Parents/PRO
observations.observation: Registration receipts were not being signed by parents and the PRO. Signatures were also found missing on copies of registration receipts submitted in accounts office.
observations.recommendation: Relevant personnel should ensure to obtain parents' signature on registration receipts to authenticate particulars such as Name, DOB, Amount Received. PRO should also sign the receipts for future reference.
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern. Will make sure this practice is in place.

observations.title: Outdated/Stale Student Security Cheques not Returned
observations.observation: Time-barred (outdated) cheques of Student Security were observed as uncollected and not returned by the branch. Three such cheques were identified.
observations.recommendation: Stale cheques should be returned on an immediate basis for reconciliation of bank balances. Proper check and follow-up should be conducted regularly for time-barred cheques.
observations.typical_response: The four cheques in campus were from students who had left for America. Cheques sent back to HO.

observations.title: Exemption/Rate Reduction Reason not Mentioned on Registration Receipts
observations.observation: Reason for exemption/rate reduction of registration receipts should be mentioned on office copy of registration receipts. Whereas, during the audit, it was identified that such detail was not being mentioned.
observations.recommendation: Reason for exemption/rate reduction of registration fee should be mentioned on receipts issued for free registrations. This information should include (but not limited to); Reference of Exemption Circular, Notification; In case of exemption notification. As per SOM, Clause, A-1.5 COLLECTION OF REGISTRATION FEE, i); “……... To keep the track of the admission process, registration receipts generated in this case shall be marked as “Exempted” along with the reason/basis”. Reason for reduction in rates should be also mentioned for future refence.
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern and will make sure the reasons are mentioned.

observations.title: GRN not Sent to RO
observations.observation: GRNs for certain fixed assets were not sent to RO. Fixed asset codes cannot be assigned without GRNs being submitted to RO.
observations.recommendation: All assets should be properly processed with GRNs forwarded to RO so that asset codes can be assigned and fixed asset register updated. 'Designated P&AM Officer at RO shall ensure that asset codes have been duly affixed on all assets.'
observations.typical_response: Noted. Concerned personnel informed to prepare GRNs and forward to relevant department.

observations.title: Fixed Assets Codes Affixed Casually/Carelessly
observations.observation: Fixed asset codes were affixed to some assets in a casual manner (e.g., Split AC, Printers, Multimedia) in a way that spoiled the outlook of the assets.
observations.recommendation: As per policy: 'Assets should be numbered clearly and neatly, such that the code does not spoil the appearance of the assets, unless such a method restricts the coding of assets.'
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern.

observations.title: Geyser Not in Use Since Purchase
observations.observation: Two geysers costing Rs. 19,000 were provided to the branch in October 2017 but had not been in use since purchase.
observations.recommendation: The item should be used effectively. Branch should seek guidance from RO for effective utilization or initiate Transfer/AIDN process.
observations.typical_response: Concern shared with OFA. Transfer/AIDN is in process.

observations.title: HO/TO of Branch Librarian not Conducted
observations.observation: A new branch librarian took over in March 2024 but her HO/TO was not conducted until the audit date in May 2024.
observations.recommendation: HO/TO process should be conducted and documented in accordance with company's policies. 'For Branch based positions, HOTO shall be conducted by the HOTO Teams and below mentioned specific forms shall also be prepared.'
observations.typical_response: HO/TO process has been conducted and recorded. Signed HO/TO document received.

observations.title: Gifted/Donated Books not Accessed in KOHA
observations.observation: 24 gifted/donated books in the PYP library were not accessed in KOHA software.
observations.recommendation: Records of books should be updated in KOHA on immediate basis. 'Gifts or donated materials will be subject to the same selection criteria as purchased materials.'
observations.typical_response: Work is in progress.

observations.title: Disposal Notes not Processed through BEAMS/KOHA
observations.observation: PYP librarian had not recorded approved disposal notes in the online accession register of branch.
observations.recommendation: Disposal notes should be processed in BEAMS/KOHA in time.
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern. Work is in progress.

observations.title: Barcode Scanner and Printer not Available in Library
observations.observation: Barcode Scanner and Printer were not available with the library computer system, preventing proper undisturbed working on BEAMS/KOHA during classes.
observations.recommendation: For smooth running of BEAMS module, Barcode Scanner and Printer should be attached to the library computer system. 'A Printer should be available for report and label printing. UPS should be provided for BEAMS support.'
observations.typical_response: Branch has asked for barcode scanner for the coming session.

observations.title: Item per Child Report not Prepared Bi-annually
observations.observation: The report of Item per Child should be prepared and send to CSO biannually in the months of June and December, however, during the audit it was observed that branch was not preparing the stated report on biannual basis.
observations.recommendation: Item per child report should be prepared and sent to regional (cluster) librarian on regular bases as defined in the library manual clause No. 18.1: “A school librarian should always be fully aware of her library material, student strength and items per child. For this purpose she should fill a form titled” Record of Library material / student strength and Items per child”. This form should be filled in the months of June and December. This should be displayed on the library soft board. A copy of the same should be sent to the Regional (Cluster) Librarian and one copy kept for their record.”
observations.audit_view: In light of the attached clause of library manual, same is required on biannual basis. The branch management is requested to ensure the compliance or get an approval for waiver of the clause.
observations.typical_response: Noted the concern.

observations.title: In-Effective Screening Room
observations.observation: Screening room should be properly closed and locked from both sides to ensure that any visitor can only enter the building once cleared by the security staff. During audit it was noted that screening room function was in-effective as rear door was always open and there was no armed guard to cover the main point of entry.
observations.recommendation: The rear gate should always be closed and should only be opened after specific caution by the security staff positioned inside the screening room. As per Chapter-4, “Charter of Duties” of Security guidelines “SOP for the New Security Paradigm” stating common duties of Chawkidar (School Guard): “Lady Searcher will knock the inner door with preset signal for Chawkidar to open and an escort from school to lead the visitor to the visited person.”
observations.typical_response: Concern shared with the security supervisor.

observations.title: Discrepancy in Weekly Maintenance of Weapon
observations.observation: Record of pistol maintenance (cleaning and lubricating) was not available with the branch. The weapon had been received since October 2017 but no maintenance record was maintained.
observations.recommendation: As per Pistol Handling SOPs: 'Weapon's weekly cleaning and lubrication is the responsibility of SSS; for which register entry will be done and counter-signed by SGSM.'
observations.typical_response: Will ensure weekly cleaning/oiling of the pistol and update the record accordingly.

observations.title: Shortcomings in Sports Register
observations.observation: Stocks registers should be properly maintained and validated by Branch Head, as prescribed in company policy. Whereas, in the register certain discrepancies were observed such as; The register was not validated by Branch Head, as specified in SOM. No record available before; August 2018 (Girls Section). April 2015 (Primary Section). August 2019 (Boys Section). In the registers of Girls Section & Primary Section, items in use were marked as stock out, and reduced from balance of stock in hand. In the register of Girls Section, stock in hand was not added with receipts, and hence the total was incorrect. In Primary Section, date of purchase was not mentioned. Acknowledgment of issued items was not obtained. 3 PT drums were not recorded in the sports register.
observations.recommendation: The register should be checked by Branch Head. As per SOM, Clause, E-2.4 OTHER STOCK REGISTERS; Sports Register Sports Teacher Quarterly Old register(s) should be traced. Items in use should not be marked as “Issued” and should be reported as stock in hand. Totals should be calculated correctly. Complete particulars should be mentioned.
observations.typical_response: Will be checked and rectified by new OFA.

observations.title: Inventory Record of Landlord/Canteen Assets not Available
observations.observation: A list of fixed assets belonging to the building owner (landlord) and/or canteen contractor was not present in the branch, making it impossible to distinguish between company assets and third-party assets.
observations.recommendation: In case of rented premises, a list of landlord/canteen contractor assets should be available in the branch duly signed by both parties. RO should provide such a list to the branch.
observations.typical_response: Will be checked and recorded if any.

observations.title: Printing Stationery Register Discrepancies
observations.observation: Discrepancies were observed in the Printing Stationery Register: not regularly validated by Branch Head on monthly basis; balance does not match.
observations.recommendation: Printing stationery register should be maintained by recording receipt and issuance of all items. Register should be regularly verified by the Branch Head on a monthly basis. An immediate stock taking is suggested.
observations.typical_response: Will make sure to verify it every month.

observations.title: Chart of Accounts Needs Correction (Section Reference)
observations.observation: Chart of accounts in BEAMS was not updated. Withholding Tax on supplies was booked under section 50(4), whereas this section has been superseded by section 153-1(a) in the Income Tax Ordinance 2001.
observations.recommendation: In order to ensure compliance with applicable income tax ordinance, updates regarding tax sections should be timely updated in the system. Branch should ensure booking of tax under applicable head of accounts.
observations.typical_response: IT has been asked to update the account title.

observations.title: Quality and Brand not Mentioned for Annual Paint Work Quotations
observations.observation: Discrepancies were observed in annual paint work transactions over multiple years: Quality and Brand of paint material not mentioned on quotations, comparative statements, and final invoices; pre-scrapping, number of paint coats, and brands of paint material not clearly specified in quotations.
observations.recommendation: Core objective of obtaining quotations is fair market analysis. Improper quotations and invoices should be identified and rectified. All relevant technical specifications should be clearly mentioned in quotations and comparative statements.
observations.typical_response: Observation noted for future.

observations.title: Equal Opportunity to Contractors not Provided
observations.observation: The branch was using a single vendor to purchase goods and services of variant nature. Apparently the vendor was given favour and fair competition was not ensured at the time of awarding contracts.
observations.recommendation: Purchase committee should work on identifying specialized vendors for respective goods and services and should provide equal opportunity to all vendors. As per policy: 'Ensure that equal opportunity is provided to every genuine competitor.'
observations.typical_response: This vendor provides variety of needed goods and services at the doorstep. Will try to find more similar suppliers in future.

observations.title: Fair Comparison not Performed while Preparing CSQ
observations.observation: Quotations were not collected and compared properly. Comparative statements were prepared merely based on lowest rates without matching quality of supplies and services among quotations.
observations.recommendation: Purchase Committee should perform its duties actively. 'The comparative items given in the CSQ should be identical or comparable with each other.' Branch Head should also ensure that procurement was made in accordance with company policies.
observations.typical_response: We did not have these technical aspects in mind regarding wiring at the time of contracting. Will be careful in future.

observations.title: Review of Market Price not Carried Out for Routine Vendors
observations.observation: Review of market prices for items supplied by routine vendors was not regularly carried out. Some vendors had been supplying without fresh quotation comparison for extended periods.
observations.recommendation: As per Director Systems & Audit email dated September 26, 2013: 'For procurement of such routine items where the price and quality committed by the vendor remains unchanged, review of market prices will be carried out after every 6 months by obtaining fresh quotations from other vendors.'
observations.typical_response: Due to current inflation prices are fluctuating frequently. However, will follow the policy strictly.

observations.title: Multiple Ledger Accounts for Single Vendor
observations.observation: Multiple ledger accounts were observed for single vendors in the trial balance. These create ambiguity in books of accounts and hide the true picture of financial records.
observations.recommendation: Multiple ledger accounts should not be opened for single vendors. Care should be exercised while opening vendor accounts. Chart of accounts should be scrutinized and multiple ledger accounts for the same vendor closed accordingly.
observations.typical_response: Were created previously. Will consult RO on how to delete multiple ledger accounts.

observations.title: Deficiencies in Vendor Registration Applications (VRA)
observations.observation: VRA forms were not properly and completely filled and some were not enclosed with all required supporting documents such as CNIC, NTN, STRN numbers, and PRA registration.
observations.recommendation: VRA forms should be filled completely and carefully and duly approved by the Branch Head. 'All original applications, supporting documents, evaluation forms, correspondence and relevant information shall be duly filed in appropriate files.'
observations.typical_response: Completed VRA forms deficiencies will be addressed; will be careful in future.

observations.title: Cheque Number not Recorded in Bank Payment Vouchers
observations.observation: Cheque numbers/digital payment reference numbers for each transaction were not recorded while preparing Bank Payment Vouchers, creating difficulties at the time of Bank Reconciliation.
observations.recommendation: Cheque numbers/digital payment reference numbers for all transactions should be recorded in Bank Payment Vouchers.
observations.typical_response: These were digital payments without unique transaction references from the bank. Bank is working on a digital portal.

observations.title: Left Employee Record Missing
observations.observation: Records (personal files) of some left employees were found missing in the branch.
observations.recommendation: Record of left employees should be retained in accordance with company's policy. 'All closed files shall be retained and kept in safe custody in accordance with the Company's record retention policy.'
observations.typical_response: During R&M and annual paint works some files may have been misplaced. Will try to find these files and be careful in future.

observations.title: JDs not Signed by Some Employees
observations.observation: Job Descriptions had not been communicated and acknowledged by all branch employees. Acknowledgement signatures on Job Descriptions were not obtained from some employees.
observations.recommendation: Relevant JDs should be transacted and acknowledged by employees. As per SGHR mail: 'A signed copy shall be filed in employee personal files and one copy shall be handed over to employees for their records and information.'
observations.typical_response: Record has been updated now.

observations.title: Contractual Staff Attendance not Marked on Biometric Device
observations.observation: A contractual staff member (Gardener) was not marking his attendance on Biometric Device. Instead, his attendance was being marked on a manual attendance register.
observations.recommendation: Once an employee is hired, branch management should ensure they are registered on the Biometric Device. 'Employees shall mark their attendance on biometric devices (online attendance) installed in offices.'
observations.typical_response: Will consult with RO-HR to update his calendar in BEAMS.

observations.title: Incorrect Student Fee Challan Generated
observations.observation: Student fee challans were generated including already-paid arrears, resulting in incorrect (over-stated) fee challans being sent to parents.
observations.recommendation: Student fee challans should be generated very carefully. Fee challans should accurately reflect only the current dues. Considering company's credibility and reputation, monetary accuracy on fee challans is essential.
observations.audit_view: Company offers online integrated banking to clients (parents). Student fee challans should be generated with monetary accuracy.
observations.typical_response: Challans with arrears found; requests sent to RO for correction.

observations.title: Student Fee Exemption/Concession Forms Incomplete
observations.observation: Fee Exemption/Concession forms were not verified by Regional Accountant/Senior Manager Finance-ROS in several cases.
observations.recommendation: Students' Fee Exemption/Concession forms should be complete in all respects. 'Fee exemption/Concession Form shall be submitted to CSO/RO for verification. Employee confirmation letter shall be attached as supporting document.'
observations.typical_response: Refer to RO for this observation. Approved copy re-sent to branch.

observations.title: Complimentary Fixed Assets Accepted Without Approval
observations.observation: A complimentary laptop (Core i7) was found in the branch. Approval for accepting the gift was not obtained before acceptance. Additionally, the asset was incorrectly recorded in memorandum stock register as 'Core i3' and GRN for fixed asset codes was not raised.
observations.recommendation: Branch should accept gifts only after obtaining approval from the competent authority. 'Fixed assets received as donation/gift/free of cost shall be accepted after obtaining prior approval from the competent authority. Such fixed assets shall be capitalized at the Notional Value (i.e. Rs.1) in the books of the Company.'
observations.typical_response: Previous accountant mistakenly mentioned Core i3. Already mentioned in physical verification of 2022-23; waiting for RO to provide code.

observations.title: Assets Found in Repairable Condition
observations.observation: During physical verification some assets were found in repairable condition. No action to repair was taken by the branch.
observations.recommendation: Out of order/repairable assets should be repaired at the earliest to increase useful life and ensure smooth performance. 'All Branches/Offices will carry out periodic repair & maintenance of assets to preserve the assets in good working condition.'
observations.typical_response: Some assets transferred to Gulshan Campus; one asset repaired.

observations.title: High Item per Child Book Ratio
observations.observation: Book ratio per child was 19.8 against the standard of 15 books per child as per Student Strength & Item per Child Report. The ratio was above the prescribed standard.
observations.recommendation: Keeping in view the students' strength, the quantity of books should be decreased. Excess titles may be transferred to other libraries in the system. RO Librarian should monitor IPC ratios in all branches.
observations.typical_response: Refer to RO for this observation. Branches informed to scrutinize IPC ratio.

observations.title: Insufficient Racks for Display of Library Books
observations.observation: Many books were placed in multiple rows in racks or stacked on the floor due to insufficient space in the library. Books should be displayed in single row per rack.
observations.recommendation: The Library should be expanded in accordance with the number of books. Branch should demand more racks in CAPEX for proper display of books. 'After allocating the class number, cataloguing and labelling etc., books should be arranged on the shelf.'
observations.typical_response: Surplus books are being transferred to other branches.

observations.title: Annual Firing Practice not Conducted
observations.observation: Annual firing practice for the School Security Supervisor had not been conducted since 2019.
observations.recommendation: Regional annual firing practice should be conducted at the firing range at least once per year. 'In regional training, the firing practice will be carried out through own weapon, and official record will also be kept, and at least one time fire is necessary in a year.'
observations.typical_response: Due to COVID-19 scenario, annual firing practices could not be conducted. Planned for next vacation.

observations.title: Offline/Non-Functional CCTV Cameras
observations.observation: Following CCTV cameras were found offline (recording and display not available) due to electrical wiring short during rain.
observations.recommendation: Out of order CCTV cameras should be repaired or replaced on priority basis to avoid security concerns.
observations.typical_response: CCTV cameras were dysfunctional due to electrical wiring short during rain. Now wiring has been replaced and CCTVs are functional.

observations.title: CCTV Recording Backup Available for Short Duration Only
observations.observation: Only 7 days' backup was available for the 16-port NVR which was insufficient. At least 10 days' backup should be maintained as per standard.
observations.recommendation: At least 10 days' backup should be maintained for security purposes. 'The matter has been discussed with GM Security and it has been decided to continue the practice in vogue, i.e. recording for 10-15 days.'
observations.typical_response: UPS for CCTV system demanded in next CAPEX. 1 NVR 16 port received in CAPEX 2022-23 with 2 HDD and 10 IP cameras, waiting for installation.

observations.title: UPS not Installed with CCTV Cameras (Recording Gaps)
observations.observation: UPS was not installed with the branch CCTV cameras. CCTV cameras were powered through WAPDA only, resulting in numerous recording discontinuations during electricity load shedding and power failure.
observations.recommendation: UPS should immediately be installed with CCTV cameras to avoid uninterrupted recording and monitoring of security cameras.
observations.typical_response: UPS demanded in next CAPEX.

observations.title: Alarm Switch not Installed in Screening Room
observations.observation: Alarm switch connection was not available in the new screening room of the branch.
observations.recommendation: To tackle security-related matters, appropriate facility of alarm system should be placed in screening rooms.
observations.typical_response: Alarm switch has been installed now.

observations.title: Safety Risk Associated with Branch Building
observations.observation: Safety risks associated with the branch building were observed with respect to the rainy season: cracked roofs and boundary walls/weak structure of building area that was seeping during rain; water surrounded/immersed electric generator.
observations.recommendation: Safety of students and staff should be given utmost priority. Appropriate measures should be adopted to improve the condition of the building and to avoid the risk of any casualty. Concrete strength should be checked by core cutting before deciding on remediation.
observations.typical_response: RO informed about these risks. First step must be checking of concrete strength by core cutting. Remaining work falls under branch responsibility from Imprest funds or upcoming CAPEX.

observations.title: Bank Payments/Receipts Recorded through Journal Vouchers
observations.observation: Vouchers should be booked under the relevant voucher module. It was reported in last audit that few bank payments were recorded in imprest module through Journal Vouchers instead of Bank Payment Vouchers. During current visit it was observed that few bank payments/receipts were recorded in the imprest module through Journal Vouchers instead of Bank Payment Vouchers (BPs) & Bank Receipt Vouchers (BRs). Following is the detail; 7/Feb/17 JV – 9 Hotel Royal Palace of Peshawar Campus 7/Feb/17 JV – 10 New Shehzad Tent Service 15/Jun/17 JV-18 Seat cover for chairs 27/Dec/18 JV – 18 Payment of Photostat exp 15/Feb/19 JV – 1 Honorarium to staff from Kangroo 25/Jun/19 JV - 11 Payment made to Amna Shakil 11c 19/Sep/19 JV – 3 Cash received from student for community Development council
observations.recommendation: Bank payments/receipts should be recorded in the imprest module through Bank Payment Vouchers (BPs) & Bank Receipt Vouchers (BRs) respectively. Branch Head shall ensure that procurement was made in accordance with Company policies i.e. Quotations have been obtained. Comparative Statement have been prepared and properly kept by the branch official. As per clause G-1.9.4 of SOM: “PC shall prepare “Comparative Statement of Quotations”. Preferably three to five vendors shall be included in the Statement.” As per clause G-1.9.5 of SOM, “PO/WO is mandatory for procurement of item having cost/value Rs. 25,000 or above.” Branch Head shall ensure that procurement was made in accordance with Company policies i.e. post documentation should be avoided.

observations.title: Delay in Finalization of Final Settlement Claims
observations.observation: Final settlement claims should be finalized within 45 days from the last working day of an employee. It was noticed during current audit, that certain final settlement claims of employees were being finalized with significant delays. Same observation was reported in last audit report as well. Detail is mentioned in the below appended table; Employee ID #
observations.recommendation: All concerned authorities should play their role effectively for finalization of final settlement claims within the stipulated time. According to policy: “Final settlement of employees shall be paid within 45 days of their last working days”.
observations.audit_view: Time period for Finalization of Final Settlement Claims should be ensured and compliance with company policy should be reemphasized.

observations.title: File of Transferred in Employees not Available
